title: France is Bigger Than You Think!
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

keywords.def: an area of land controlled by a country or government
located in another country or across the sea
the legal status of being a citizen of a country
the right or ability to govern yourself
freedom from political control by another country
the process of colonies becoming independent
the process of becoming part of another culture or society

sentences.en: Which country shares the longest border with France?
sentences.zh: 哪个国家与法国拥有最长的陆地边界？

sentences.en: I think most people would say Spain. Spain is right next to France in Europe.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数人会说是西班牙。西班牙在欧洲就紧挨着法国。

sentences.en: Or perhaps you might have said Belgium, Switzerland, or Italy.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能会说是比利时、瑞士或意大利。

sentences.en: But the answer is actually Brazil. Yes, Brazil.
sentences.zh: 但答案实际上是巴西。是的，就是巴西。

sentences.en: France and Brazil share a border of more than 700 kilometres.
sentences.zh: 法国和巴西共享长达700多公里的边界。

sentences.en: The reason is French Guiana, a territory on the northeastern coast of South America which is officially part of France.
sentences.zh: 原因就是法属圭亚那，这是一个位于南美洲东北海岸的领地，它在官方行政上是法国的一部分。

sentences.en: French Guiana isn’t the only surprising part of France.
sentences.zh: 法属圭亚那并不是法国唯一令人意外的部分。

sentences.en: France has territories and departments in the Caribbean, the Indian Ocean, the Pacific, and South America.
sentences.zh: 法国在加勒比海、印度洋、太平洋和南美洲都拥有领地和省份。

sentences.en: People living in many of these places are French citizens.
sentences.zh: 许多这些地方的居民都是法国公民。

sentences.en: They can vote in French elections, use the euro, and in some cases are part of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在法国选举中投票、使用欧元，在某些情况下还是欧盟的一部分。

sentences.en: How did France end up with territory on several different continents?
sentences.zh: 法国怎么会在好几个不同的大洲上都有领土呢？

sentences.en: Why are these places still part of France, while many former British colonies became independent countries?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些地方至今仍然属于法国，而许多前英国殖民地却成了独立的国家？

sentences.en: And do the people living in these territories want to be French?
sentences.zh: 生活在这些领地的人们真的想当法国人吗？

sentences.en: In this episode, we’re going to explore Overseas France and learn some new English vocabulary along the way!
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将探索海外法国，并在过程中学习一些新的英语词汇！

sentences.en: France is bigger than you think. I’m sure most of you listening know where France is.
sentences.zh: 法国比你想象的要大。我敢肯定，收听节目的绝大多数人都知道法国在哪里。

sentences.en: You know where it is located on a map. It is a country in Western Europe.
sentences.zh: 你知道它在地图上的位置。它是西欧的一个国家。

sentences.en: It has coastlines on the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
sentences.zh: 它的海岸线濒临大西洋和地中海。

sentences.en: It has the Alps mountain range and major cities like Paris.
sentences.zh: 它拥有阿尔卑斯山脉以及巴黎这样的大城市。

sentences.en: It borders Spain, Andorra, Belgium, Switzerland, Italy, Germany, Luxembourg, and Monaco.
sentences.zh: 它与西班牙、安道尔、比利时、瑞士、意大利、德国、卢森堡和摩纳哥接壤。

sentences.en: This part of France is called Metropolitan France.
sentences.zh: 法国这部分被称为法国本土。

sentences.en: It includes the European mainland and the island of Corsica in the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 它包括欧洲大陆以及地中海上的科西嘉岛。

sentences.en: But legally and politically, France is bigger than this.
sentences.zh: 但从法律和政治角度来看，法国的范围比这更大。

sentences.en: The Republic of France also includes a collection of territories and islands located thousands of kilometers away from Europe.
sentences.zh: 法兰西共和国还包括一系列距离欧洲数千公里远的领土和岛屿。

sentences.en: Some of these are in the Caribbean, some in the Indian Ocean, one is in South America, and others are scattered across the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 其中一些位于加勒比海，一些在印度洋，一个在南美洲，还有一些散落在大平洋各处。

sentences.en: Some of these places are officially part of France itself.
sentences.zh: 其中一些地方在官方上就是法国本身的一部分。

sentences.en: They’re not a territory of France. They’re not owned by France.
sentences.zh: 它们不是法国的附属领地。它们不属于被法国占有的殖民地。

sentences.en: They are France. For example, French Guiana is an overseas department of France.
sentences.zh: 它们就是法国。例如，法属圭亚那便是法国的一个海外省。

sentences.en: Martinique and Guadeloupe in the Caribbean are also overseas departments.
sentences.zh: 加勒比海的马提尼克和瓜德罗普也是海外省。

sentences.en: Réunion, an island in the Indian Ocean, is another one.
sentences.zh: 留尼汪，这座位于印度洋的岛屿，也是其中之一。

sentences.en: This means that these places are parts of the French Republic.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这些地方都是法兰西共和国的组成部分。

sentences.en: Someone born in French Guiana is a French citizen.
sentences.zh: 在法属圭亚那出生的人就是法国公民。

sentences.en: They use the euro as their currency. People in French Guiana can vote in French presidential elections, and they also elect representatives to the French Parliament.
sentences.zh: 他们使用欧元作为货币。法属圭亚那的人民可以在法国总统选举中投票，他们还会选出代表进入法国议会。

sentences.en: The same is true for people in places like Martinique and Réunion.
sentences.zh: 马提尼克和留尼汪等地的人也是如此。

sentences.en: Why? Why is France stretched across territories thousands of kilometers away from Paris?
sentences.zh: 为什么？为什么法国的领土会延伸到距离巴黎数千公里之外的地方？

sentences.en: The answer to this question is colonialism.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的答案就是殖民主义。

sentences.en: To be honest, whenever we talk about the history of Europe, colonialism is often the answer to questions.
sentences.zh: 老实说，每当我们在讨论欧洲历史时，殖民主义往往就是许多问题的答案。

sentences.en: From around the 17th century onwards, France became one of the world’s major colonial powers.
sentences.zh: 大约从17世纪开始，法国成为了世界主要的殖民强国之一。

sentences.en: Just like Britain, Spain, Portugal, and the Netherlands, France had colonies and trading posts around the world.
sentences.zh: 就像英国、西班牙、葡萄牙和荷兰一样，法国在世界各地拥有殖民地和贸易据点。

sentences.en: The French Empire controlled enormous areas of territory.
sentences.zh: 法兰西帝国控制了极其广袤的领土。

sentences.en: There were French colonies in North and South America, the Caribbean, Africa, Asia, the Indian Ocean, and the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 法国在北美洲、南美洲、加勒比海、非洲、亚洲、印度洋和太平洋都拥有殖民地。

sentences.en: We’ve talked about some French colonies relatively recently when I discussed the history of Canada and the US Declaration of Independence.
sentences.zh: 前不久，当我讨论加拿大历史和美国《独立宣言》时，我们就谈到过一些法国殖民地。

sentences.en: Both of those topics were connected to the battle between Britain and France over control of North America.
sentences.zh: 这两个话题都与英法争夺北美控制权的斗争有关。

sentences.en: But after the Second World War, this system of colonialism began to collapse.
sentences.zh: 但二战后，这种殖民主义体系开始崩溃。

sentences.en: Not just for France, of course, for all European empires.
sentences.zh: 当然，不仅对法国如此，对所有欧洲帝国都是如此。

sentences.en: Across Asia and Africa, people were demanding independence.
sentences.zh: 在整个亚洲和非洲，人们都在要求独立。

sentences.en: European countries had been weakened by the two world wars, and these huge overseas empires were becoming uncontrollable.
sentences.zh: 两次世界大战削弱了欧洲国家的力量，这些庞大的海外帝国变得无法控制。

sentences.en: Keeping them was really difficult. Britain, for example, gradually granted independence to almost all of its colonies.
sentences.zh: 保留它们真的很难。例如，英国逐渐给予了几乎所有殖民地独立地位。

sentences.en: India became independent in 1947, Nigeria in 1960, Jamaica in 1962, many others in that same period as well.
sentences.zh: 印度于1947年独立，尼日利亚于1960年独立，牙买加于1962年独立，许多其他国家也在这一时期相继独立。

sentences.en: France went through a similar process. It lost Vietnam after the First Indochina War.
sentences.zh: 法国也经历了类似的过程。它在第一次印度支那战争后失去了越南。

sentences.en: Algeria became independent after a violent war in 1962.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚在1962年经历了一场暴力战争后获得独立。

sentences.en: In fact, during the 1950s and 60s, most of France’s other African colonies also became independent.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在上世纪50和60年代，法国在非洲的其他大部分殖民地也都独立了。

sentences.en: But France didn’t believe that every territory or every place had to become an independent country.
sentences.zh: 但法国并不认为每一块领土或每一个地方都必须成为独立的国家。

sentences.en: In 1946, France made a constitutional change.
sentences.zh: 1946年，法国进行了宪法修改。

sentences.en: Several of its colonies, or former colonies, including Guadeloupe, Martinique, French Guiana, and Réunion, became overseas departments.
sentences.zh: 它的几个殖民地，或者说前殖民地，包括瓜德罗普、马提尼克、法属圭亚那和留尼汪，都变成了海外省。

sentences.en: A department is a administrative division of France.
sentences.zh: 一个“省”（department）是法国的一个行政区划。

sentences.en: Metropolitan France, so mainland France, is also divided into departments.
sentences.zh: 法国本土，也就是欧洲大陆上的法国，也被划分为各个省份。

sentences.en: I guess it’s a bit like a state or a prefecture or a province.
sentences.zh: 我想这有点类似于美国的州、日本的县或者中国的省。

sentences.en: In France, they’re called departments. Legally, these territories, like Guadeloupe in the Caribbean or French Guiana in South America, became parts of France.
sentences.zh: 在法国，它们被称为“省”。从法律上讲，加勒比海的瓜德罗普或南美洲的法属圭亚那这些领地，都成为了法国的一部分。

sentences.en: The French Republican model, the ideology, the belief system behind France, emphasizes a few key ideas.
sentences.zh: 法兰西共和国的模式、意识形态以及法国背后的信仰体系，强调了几个核心理念。

sentences.en: One of these is the idea of one nation, and connected to that is the idea of one citizenship and equality before the law.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是单一民族的概念，与之相关的则是单一公民权和法律面前人人平等的理念。

sentences.en: Based on these principles, France made people in these new overseas departments French citizens and made these departments part of France.
sentences.zh: 基于这些原则，法国让这些新海外省的人民成为了法国公民，并使这些省份成为了法国的一部分。

sentences.en: The people there should have the same rights as French citizens in Paris.
sentences.zh: 那里的居民应该享有与巴黎法国公民相同的权利。

sentences.en: This was quite different from other European empires, like the UK.
sentences.zh: 这与英国等其他欧洲帝国有着很大不同。

sentences.en: The UK still has some overseas territories, famously still has overseas territories, but they are not part of the United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 英国至今仍有一些海外领地，这很有名，但它们并不是英国的一部分。

sentences.en: They are almost all self-governing, and they are not part of Great Britain or the UK.
sentences.zh: 它们几乎全都是自治的，既不属于大不列颠，也不属于英国。

sentences.en: They are protected by the UK, but they are not part of the UK.
sentences.zh: 它们受英国保护，但并不属于英国。

sentences.en: Places like Bermuda and the Cayman Islands and Gibraltar have their own local parliaments and they are internally self-governing.
sentences.zh: 百慕大、开曼群岛和直布罗陀等地拥有自己的地方议会，并且内部实行自治。

sentences.en: They make their own laws. But they are not part of the UK.
sentences.zh: 它们制定自己的法律。但它们不是英国的一部分。

sentences.en: The people living there cannot vote in UK elections unless they are living in the UK.
sentences.zh: 住在那里的人不能在英国大选中投票，除非他们住在英国本土。

sentences.en: But if you’re living in Gibraltar, you can’t vote in the UK election, and there are no members of Parliament for Gibraltar in the UK Parliament.
sentences.zh: 但如果你住在直布罗陀，你就不能在英国大选中投票，而且英国议会中也没有直布罗陀的国会议员。

sentences.en: France did something different to Britain, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，法国的做法与英国不同。

sentences.en: France did something closer to assimilation.
sentences.zh: 法国采取了更接近同化政策的做法。

sentences.en: Rather than France owning territories, France considered the territories to be French.
sentences.zh: 法国并没有单纯地“拥有”领地，而是认为这些领地本身就是法国。

sentences.en: France expanded its borders. It grew. Was this a genuine attempt to create equality, or was it just another form of colonialism?
sentences.zh: 法国扩大了它的边界。它壮大了。这究竟是真诚地试图创造平等，还是仅仅是另一种形式的殖民主义？

sentences.en: Maybe we’ll talk about that a bit later in the episode.
sentences.zh: 也许我们会在本集的后面再讨论这个问题。

sentences.en: But first, we should probably take a look at some of these overseas departments, overseas territories, overseas collectivities.
sentences.zh: 但首先，我们或许应该看一看其中一些海外省、海外领地和海外集体。

sentences.en: I just mentioned three different types of thing… departments, territories, and collectivities.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚提到了三种不同类型的东西……省、领地和集体。

sentences.en: And that should tell you that Overseas France is not one single place.
sentences.zh: 这应该能说明，海外法国并不是一个单一的地方。

sentences.en: Some of these places are legally almost identical to mainland France.
sentences.zh: 其中一些地方在法律上几乎与法国本土完全相同。

sentences.en: Others have more autonomy. Some strongly identify as being French.
sentences.zh: 另一些则拥有更大的自主权。有些地方强烈认同自己是法国人。

sentences.en: Others are a bit more independence-minded.
sentences.zh: 另一些则稍微更有独立倾向。

sentences.en: There are overseas departments and regions.
sentences.zh: 这里有海外省和海外大区。

sentences.en: These places are fully part of the French Republic, and they are part of the EU as well.
sentences.zh: 这些地方完全属于法兰西共和国，它们也是欧盟的一部分。

sentences.en: Then there are overseas collectivities that have a different level of self-rule, so they can make their own laws.
sentences.zh: 然后还有享有不同程度自治权的海外集体，因此它们可以制定自己的法律。

sentences.en: They don’t rely on the French Parliament just to make laws.
sentences.zh: 它们并不完全依赖法国议会来制定法律。

sentences.en: I believe that all residents of Overseas France are citizens of France, which means they can all vote in French elections.
sentences.zh: 我相信所有海外法国的居民都是法国公民，这意味着他们都可以在法国选举中投票。

sentences.en: But not all parts of Overseas France are in the EU.
sentences.zh: 但并非海外法国的所有部分都在欧盟境内。

sentences.en: Most of the overseas collectivities are not in the EU, with, I think, one exception.
sentences.zh: 大多数海外集体都不在欧盟内，我想只有一个例外。

sentences.en: And then there is also one overseas territory of France as well.
sentences.zh: 然后法国还有一个海外领地。

sentences.en: I should also mention that I will be using the English pronunciation and names of all of these places.
sentences.zh: 我还应该提一下，我将使用所有这些地方的英语发音和英文名称。

sentences.en: In France, in French, they’re different, but this is an English learning podcast, so let’s learn the English names for these places.
sentences.zh: 在法国，用法语说它们的叫法是不同的，但这是一档英语学习播客，所以让我们来学习这些地方的英文名字吧。

sentences.en: French Guiana is on the northeastern coast of South America, between Brazil and Suriname.
sentences.zh: 法属圭亚那位于南美洲东北海岸，夹在巴西和苏里南之间。

sentences.en: It is larger than a country like Austria, and most of French Guiana is covered by rainforest, the Amazon rainforest.
sentences.zh: 它的面积比奥地利这样的国家还要大，法属圭亚那的大部分地区都被雨林所覆盖，也就是亚马逊雨林。

sentences.en: French Guiana perhaps is best known outside of France for being home to the European Space Center.
sentences.zh: 在法国境外，法属圭亚那最著名的或许是它拥有欧洲太空中心。

sentences.en: The Guiana Space Center is Europe’s most important space launching facility.
sentences.zh: 圭亚那太空中心是欧洲最重要的太空发射设施。

sentences.en: And because French Guiana is an overseas department, the people living there are French citizens.
sentences.zh: 由于法属圭亚那是一个海外省，那里的居民就是法国公民。

sentences.en: They can use the Euro, participate in elections.
sentences.zh: 他们可以使用欧元，参与选举。

sentences.en: They’re French. You can travel from French Guiana to Paris without leaving France.
sentences.zh: 他们就是法国人。你可以从法属圭亚那前往巴黎，而无需离开法国领土。

sentences.en: Guadeloupe and Martinique are two French islands in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 瓜德罗普和马提尼克是加勒比海上的两个法国岛屿。

sentences.en: Politically, they’re also departments of France, and they are also part of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 从政治上讲，它们也是法国的省份，并且也是欧盟的一部分。

sentences.en: Both of these islands have histories that was heavily dominated by the sugar industry and slavery.
sentences.zh: 这两座岛屿的历史都深受糖业和奴隶制的支配。

sentences.en: Large numbers of enslaved Africans were taken to the Caribbean to work on plantations, to work on sugar plantations, and these islands have a legacy of slavery that I guess continues to influence their society.
sentences.zh: 大量的被奴役非洲人被带到加勒比海地区的种植园工作，在蔗糖种植园里劳作，这些岛屿留下的奴隶制遗产，我想至今仍在影响着它们的社会。

sentences.en: For example, people in Guadeloupe and Martinique speak French, but there are also Caribbean Creole languages as well, and some different unique traditions are common.
sentences.zh: 例如，瓜德罗普和马提尼克的居民说法语，但那里也有加勒比克里奥尔语，并且流行一些独特的传统。

sentences.en: Réunion is an island in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar.
sentences.zh: 留尼汪是印度洋上的一座岛屿，位于马达加斯加的东部。

sentences.en: It is a tropical and volcanic island known for its mountains and forests and volcanoes.
sentences.zh: 这是一座热带火山岛，以其山脉、森林和火山而闻名。

sentences.en: Once again, Réunion is officially part of France, but it is more than 9,000 kilometers away from Paris.
sentences.zh: 同样，留尼汪官方上是法国的一部分，但它距离巴黎有9,000多公里。

sentences.en: Culturally, Réunion is extremely diverse.
sentences.zh: 从文化上讲，留尼汪极其多元化。

sentences.en: It has influences from Africa, Europe, India, China, and other parts of the Indian Ocean.
sentences.zh: 它受到了来自非洲、欧洲、印度、中国以及印度洋其他地区的影响。

sentences.en: The closest places to Réunion are Madagascar and Mauritius, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，距离留尼汪最近的地方是马达加斯加和毛里求斯。

sentences.en: Mayotte is another French island in the Indian Ocean, this time in the Comoros Archipelago.
sentences.zh: 马约特是印度洋上的另一座法国岛屿，这次位于科摩罗群岛。

sentences.en: The Comoros Islands is an independent country.
sentences.zh: 科摩罗群岛是一个独立的国家。

sentences.en: When the Comoros Islands became independent from France in 1975, Mayotte chose to remain French.
sentences.zh: 当科摩罗群岛于1975年脱离法国独立时，马约特选择继续留在法国。

sentences.en: It eventually became an overseas department in 2011.
sentences.zh: 它最终在2011年成为了一个海外省。

sentences.en: However, the neighboring country of Comoros continues to claim Mayotte as its territory.
sentences.zh: 然而，邻国科摩罗继续宣称马约特是其领土。

sentences.en: Mayotte is one of France’s poorest departments.
sentences.zh: 马约特是法国最贫穷的省份之一。

sentences.en: So despite being part of this wealthy European country, Mayotte has a high level of poverty.
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管它是这个富裕的欧洲国家的一部分，但马约特仍有着很高的贫困率。

sentences.en: French Polynesia is different, very different.
sentences.zh: 法属波利尼西亚则不同，非常不同。

sentences.en: It includes famous islands like Tahiti. Politically, French Polynesia isn’t an overseas department like French Guiana or Martinique.
sentences.zh: 它包括塔希提岛等著名的岛屿。在政治上，法属波利尼西亚不像法属圭亚那或马提尼克那样是一个海外省。

sentences.en: It has a greater degree of autonomy or self-control.
sentences.zh: 它拥有更大程度的自治权或自我管理权。

sentences.en: Since 2004, it has been given the title of “overseas country” by the French government, but this has no different meaning from “overseas collectivity” in practice.
sentences.zh: 自2004年以来，它被法国政府授予了“海外国家”的称号，但这在实践中与“海外集体”没有什么不同。

sentences.en: Collectivity was one of the other terms the French government uses to describe Overseas France.
sentences.zh: “集体”是法国政府用来描述海外法国的另一个术语。

sentences.en: As a overseas collectivity, French Polynesia can make its own laws.
sentences.zh: 作为海外集体，法属波利尼西亚可以制定自己的法律。

sentences.en: France still controls things like defense and foreign affairs, but French Polynesia has its own government, has its own parliament, and manages most of its own issues.
sentences.zh: 法国仍然控制着国防和外交等事务，但法属波利尼西亚拥有自己的政府、自己的议会，并管理着绝大部分自身的事务。

sentences.en: The relationship between French Polynesia and France has been a bit complicated historically due to nuclear testing.
sentences.zh: 由于核试验的原因，历史上法属波利尼西亚与法国的关系一直有些复杂。

sentences.en: France conducted nuclear weapons tests in the Pacific Ocean in the region of French Polynesia from the 1960s until the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 从20世纪60年代到90年代，法国在太平洋法属波利尼西亚地区进行了核武器试验。

sentences.en: These tests have had major health consequences and environmental consequences for the region, and they remain quite a controversial part of this relationship between French Polynesia and France.
sentences.zh: 这些试验给该地区带来了严重的健康和环境后果，它们至今仍是法属波利尼西亚与法国关系中颇具争议的一部分。

sentences.en: But of course, people in French Polynesia are French citizens, and they can vote in French elections.
sentences.zh: 但当然，法属波利尼西亚的人民是法国公民，他们可以在法国选举中投票。

sentences.en: They’re not in the EU, though. And you might remember that during the Paris Olympics, the surfing competitions were hosted in French Polynesia in Tahiti New Caledonia is another French territory in the Pacific and probably the most politically complicated example.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们并不在欧盟境内。你可能还记得，在巴黎奥运会上，冲浪比赛就是在法属波利尼西亚的大溪地举行的，而新喀里多尼亚是法国在太平洋的另一个领地，也可能是政治情况最复杂的例子。

sentences.en: New Caledonia has a special status. It is an overseas collectivity, but it’s got a special status.
sentences.zh: 新喀里多尼亚拥有特殊的地位。它是一个海外集体，但拥有特殊地位。

sentences.en: This has allowed New Caledonia to gain more power and perhaps eventually become independent from France if that’s what the people there want.
sentences.zh: 这使得新喀里多尼亚获得了更多权力，如果当地人民愿意的话，甚至可能最终脱离法国独立。

sentences.en: It is located thousands of kilometers away from France, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，它距离法国有数千公里之遥。

sentences.en: It’s in the Pacific. And it has significant deposits of nickel, which is an important mineral used in various industries.
sentences.zh: 它位于太平洋。而且它拥有大量的镍矿储量，这是一种用于各种工业的重要矿物。

sentences.en: New Caledonia has a large Kanak population.
sentences.zh: 新喀里多尼亚拥有庞大的卡纳克人口。

sentences.en: The Kanaks are the indigenous peoples of the islands, and most Kanak people have supported independence from France for a long time.
sentences.zh: 卡纳克人是这些岛屿的土著居民，大多数卡纳克人长期以来一直支持脱离法国独立。

sentences.en: This desire for independence has led to decades of political tension between the Kanak people and settlers on the island, often European settlers.
sentences.zh: 这种对独立的渴望导致了卡纳克人与岛上定居者（通常是欧洲定居者）之间数十年的政治紧张局势。

sentences.en: There have been lots of protests and outbreaks of violence over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，这里发生了许多抗议活动和暴力冲突。

sentences.en: New Caledonia has held several referendums on independence recently.
sentences.zh: 新喀里多尼亚最近举行了几次关于独立的公投。

sentences.en: The majority of New Caledonia has voted to remain part of France in those three referendums between 2018 and 2021, although the final vote in 2021 was boycotted by the pro-independence movement, which means most of them didn’t vote.
sentences.zh: 在2018年至2021年期间的三次公投中，新喀里多尼亚多数人投票决定继续留在法国，尽管2021年的最后一次投票遭到独立派运动的抵制，这意味着他们大多数人没有投票。

sentences.en: The other parts of Overseas France are Saint Barthélemy or St.
sentences.zh: 海外法国的其他部分是圣巴泰勒米或简称圣巴茨，

sentences.en: Barts, which is an island in the Caribbean that became an overseas collectivity in 2003 and is not part of the EU.
sentences.zh: 巴茨是加勒比海的一个岛屿，于2003年成为海外集体，不是欧盟的一部分。

sentences.en: Saint Martin, which is also in the Caribbean and was once part of Guadaloupe, but voted to become a separate place in 2003 and is part of the EU.
sentences.zh: 圣马丁也位于加勒比海，曾是瓜德罗普的一部分，但在2003年投票成为一个独立的地方，并且是欧盟的一部分。

sentences.en: I think it’s the only overseas collectivity that is in the EU.
sentences.zh: 我想这是唯一一个属于欧盟的海外集体。

sentences.en: Saint Pierre and Miquelon are islands that are very close to Canada, right next to Canada, that used to be a department of France, but since 2003 has been a self-ruling collectivity.
sentences.zh: 圣皮埃尔和密克隆是紧邻加拿大、非常靠近加拿大的岛屿，曾经是法国的一个省，但自2003年以来一直是一个自治集体。

sentences.en: And then there is also the Wallis and Futuna Islands in the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 然后还有太平洋上的瓦利斯和富图纳群岛。

sentences.en: France also has one overseas territory, legally speaking.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，法国还有一个海外领地。

sentences.en: We can describe all of these as territories in a general sense because they’re land, but in a legal sense, France has one overseas territory, which is the French Southern and Antarctic Lands.
sentences.zh: 我们可以从广义上将所有这些描述为领地，因为它们是土地，但在法律意义上，法国有一个海外领地，那就是法属南部和南极领地。

sentences.en: And then there is also Clipperton Island, where no one lives and is off the coast of Mexico.
sentences.zh: 然后还有克利珀特恩岛，那里无人居住，位于墨西哥海岸附近。

sentences.en: So in total, there are 13 parts of Overseas France.
sentences.zh: 所以总共有13个法属海外部分。

sentences.en: French Guiana, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Réunion, Mayotte, French Polynesia, New Caledonia, Saint Barthélemy, Saint Martin, Saint Pierre and Miquelon, the French Southern and Antarctic Lands, and Clipperton Island.
sentences.zh: 法属圭亚那、瓜德罗普、马提尼克、留尼汪、马约特、法属波利尼西亚、新喀里多尼亚、圣巴泰勒米、圣马丁、圣皮埃尔和密克隆、法属南部和南极领地，以及克利珀特恩岛。

sentences.en: All of these places are far away from Paris.
sentences.zh: 所有这些地方都距离巴黎很远。

sentences.en: Some are on the other side of the world in the Pacific Ocean, really far away.
sentences.zh: 有些在太平洋的另一端，真的非常遥远。

sentences.en: Maintaining life and society in these places isn’t cheap for France.
sentences.zh: 对法国来说，维持这些地方的生活和社会成本并不低廉。

sentences.en: France has to invest a lot in public services and infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 法国必须在公共服务和基础设施上投入巨资。

sentences.en: France has territory that is scattered across the Atlantic, Caribbean, Indian Ocean, and the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 法国的领地散布在大西洋、加勒比海、印度洋和太平洋。

sentences.en: So that gives France a global presence. The French military has bases in quite a few of these overseas territories.
sentences.zh: 因此，这赋予了法国全球影响力。法国军队在其中相当一部分海外领地设有基地。

sentences.en: Having military bases around the world gives France strategic power and allows France to respond quickly to events in different parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界各地拥有军事基地赋予了法国战略力量，并使法国能够对世界不同地区的事件作出快速反应。

sentences.en: This is important for France because France sees itself as a global power.
sentences.zh: 这对外法国非常重要，因为法国视自己为一个全球大国。

sentences.en: France sees itself as being particularly influential, of course in Europe, but also in the Indo-Pacific region.
sentences.zh: 法国认为自己具有特殊影响力，当然是在欧洲，但也包括印太地区。

sentences.en: France’s territories in Réunion and Mayotte are in the Indian Ocean, and French Polynesia and New Caledonia are in the Pacific, so France considers itself to be a power in this region.
sentences.zh: 法国在留尼汪和马约特的领地位于印度洋，而法属波利尼西亚和新喀里多尼亚位于太平洋，因此法国认为自己是这一地区的大国。

sentences.en: There’s another huge advantage for France that comes from all of these islands.
sentences.zh: 所有这些岛屿还给法国带来了另一个巨大的优势。

sentences.en: France has one of the largest Exclusive Economic Zones in the world.
sentences.zh: 法国拥有世界上最大的专属经济区之一。

sentences.en: An Exclusive Economic Zone is an area of ocean which extends up to 200 nautical miles from a country’s coast.
sentences.zh: 专属经济区是指从一国海岸线延伸达200海里的海洋区域。

sentences.en: Within this zone, a country has the special rights to explore and use marine resources.
sentences.zh: 在此区域内，一国拥有勘探和利用海洋资源的特殊权利。

sentences.en: Within the area around your country, you are allowed to exclusively fish, use the resources in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 在贵国周围的区域内，您被允许专有捕鱼、利用海洋资源。

sentences.en: Because France has so many islands and so many territories across the world, its maritime territory is enormous.
sentences.zh: 由于法国在世界各地拥有如此多的岛屿和领地，其海洋领土极其庞大。

sentences.en: Some of these territories have really valuable natural resources.
sentences.zh: 其中一些领地拥有真正宝贵的自然资源。

sentences.en: New Caledonia has enormous deposits of nickel, and the surrounding oceans provide fishing resources and other marine resources as well.
sentences.zh: 新喀里多尼亚拥有巨额的镍矿储量，周围的海洋也提供了渔业资源和其他海洋资源。

sentences.en: Places like Martinique, Guadeloupe, Réunion, French Polynesia have lots of tourists from around the world.
sentences.zh: 像马提尼克、瓜德罗普、留尼汪、法属波利尼西亚这样的地方吸引了来自世界各地的众多游客。

sentences.en: And French Guiana, of course, has the space industry.
sentences.zh: 当然，法属圭亚那拥有航天工业。

sentences.en: I guess what this means is that these territories provide France with economic opportunities and resources.
sentences.zh: 我想这意味着这些领地为法国提供了经济机会和资源。

sentences.en: They’re not just empty islands. They’re not just expensive wastes of resources.
sentences.zh: 它们不仅仅是空岛。它们不仅仅是昂贵的资源浪费。

sentences.en: They’re opportunities for France. There’s something even more fundamental here.
sentences.zh: 它们对法国来说是机遇。这里还有更根本的东西。

sentences.en: The overseas departments and overseas collectivities are parts of France.
sentences.zh: 海外省和海外集体是法国的一部分。

sentences.en: French Guiana isn’t a French colony. French Guiana is France, technically, legally right now.
sentences.zh: 法属圭亚那不是法国的殖民地。从技术和法律上讲，现在的法属圭亚那本身就是法国。

sentences.en: A lot of people living in these territories genuinely identify as French.
sentences.zh: 生活在这些领地中的许多人真心认同自己是法国人。

sentences.en: They have French citizenship. They can move to the mainland if they want to.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有法国国籍。如果愿意，他们可以搬到法国本土。

sentences.en: They have French passports. People, of course, have strong local identities.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有法国护照。当然，人们有着强烈的本土认同感。

sentences.en: Someone from New Caledonia might have a strong Kanak identity.
sentences.zh: 来自新喀里多尼亚的人可能拥有强烈的卡纳克身份认同。

sentences.en: Someone from Réunion might feel Réunionese and French.
sentences.zh: 来自留尼汪的人可能会觉得自己既是留尼汪人又是法国人。

sentences.en: But this doesn’t mean that everyone in Overseas France is happy all the time.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着外海法国的每个人时时刻刻都很开心。

sentences.en: Most people in Overseas France consider themselves French, but there are significant independence movements.
sentences.zh: 外海法国的大多数人认为自己是法国人，但也有重大的独立运动。

sentences.en: Being part of France, of course, brings advantages to the people living there.
sentences.zh: 当然，成为法国的一部分给那里的人们带来了优势。

sentences.en: You can receive French healthcare, get French citizenship, move to France if you wish, attend French schools and universities, benefit from some of the support from the French government.
sentences.zh: 你可以享受法国的医疗保健，获得法国国籍，如果你愿意可以搬到法国，就读法国学校和大学，受益于法国政府的一些支持。

sentences.en: Most of the overseas departments can benefit from being in the EU, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，大多数海外省都可以从加入欧盟中受益。

sentences.en: But there are also downsides. The cost of living in Overseas France is really high.
sentences.zh: 但也有缺点。外海法国的生活成本真的很高。

sentences.en: Part of this is due to import dependency.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是对进口的依赖。

sentences.en: Most of the islands and territories are remote and isolated.
sentences.zh: 大多数岛屿和领地偏远且孤立。

sentences.en: They’re small, and they don’t have the land or the resources to grow all the food they need or to make all of the things they use.
sentences.zh: 它们很小，没有土地或资源来种植所需的所有食物，也没有资源来制造所有使用的物品。

sentences.en: This means they have to import food and import necessities from France and other EU countries, and this is expensive.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它们必须从法国和其他欧盟国家进口食物和必需品，这代价高昂。

sentences.en: You have to ship things across the world via expensive boats.
sentences.zh: 你必须通过昂贵的船只将物品运送过世界。

sentences.en: Some French territories have luxury tourism industries like Saint Barthélemy, Saint Barts, I think I’ve heard it called before, and it’s very popular for luxury tourism, but that doesn’t necessarily benefit the local people.
sentences.zh: 一些法国领地拥有豪华旅游业，比如圣巴泰勒米，也就是我听人叫过的圣巴茨，它非常受豪华旅游欢迎，但这未必能让当地人受益。

sentences.en: The hotels are probably owned by people not from the island.
sentences.zh: 这些酒店可能由不属于该岛的人拥有。

sentences.en: The cost of living in some of these islands is higher than living in parts of mainland France.
sentences.zh: 其中一些岛屿的生活成本甚至高于法国本土部分地区的生活。

sentences.en: Overseas departments like Guadeloupe typically have twice as much poverty as the mainland, while Mayotte has up to five times more poverty.
sentences.zh: 像瓜德罗普这样的海外省的贫困率通常是本土的两倍，而马约特的贫困率高达五倍。

sentences.en: I think 70% of people on Mayotte are considered to be living in poverty.
sentences.zh: 我想马约特70%的人口被认为生活在贫困之中。

sentences.en: The GDP per capita there is just 12,000 euros compared to being closer to 30,000 euros in mainland France.
sentences.zh: 那里的国民人均生产总值仅为12,000欧元，而法国本土则接近30,000欧元。

sentences.en: People in these overseas departments and collectivities are legally citizens of a wealthy, powerful European country, but they live in a place with lower incomes and fewer opportunities.
sentences.zh: 这些海外省和海外集体的人民在法律上是一个富裕、强大的欧洲国家的公民，但他们生活在一个收入较低、机会较少的地方。

sentences.en: There are higher rates of unemployment on these islands, and people from Overseas France are far less likely to go to university than someone from mainland France.
sentences.zh: 这些岛屿的失业率更高，外海法国人上大学的可能性远低于法国本土人。

sentences.en: All of this leads to frustration. And then there is the question of identity.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都导致了挫败感。然后就是身份认同的问题。

sentences.en: French identity can feel like a reminder of colonialism for some of the indigenous peoples in Overseas France.
sentences.zh: 对海外法国的一些原住民来说，法国认同感可能会让人想起殖民主义。

sentences.en: Now, like I said before, most people in Overseas France probably feel French, but not everyone does, and New Caledonia is the clearest example.
sentences.zh: 如前所述，外海法国的大多数人可能觉得自己是法国人，但并非所有人都这样，新喀里多尼亚就是最明显的例子。

sentences.en: The indigenous Kanak population has a long history of opposing French rule, and New Caledonia has held several independence referendums.
sentences.zh: 当地的卡纳克土著人口有着反抗法国统治的悠久历史，新喀里多尼亚已经举行了多次独立公投。

sentences.en: In the 2018 referendum, about 57% of New Caledonia voted to remain part of France.
sentences.zh: 在2018年的公投中，约有57%的新喀里多尼亚人投票决定留在法国。

sentences.en: In 2020, the result was closer. About 53% voted to stay part of France.
sentences.zh: 2020年，结果更加接近。约有53%的人投票决定留在法国。

sentences.en: Then in 2021, another referendum was held, but during this referendum, the pro-independence movement, the movement calling for New Caledonia to be a country not part of France, boycotted the vote due to disagreements about COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 然后在2021年，又举行了一次公投，但在这次公投期间，独立派运动（即呼吁新喀里多尼亚成为一个不属于法国的国家的运动）由于对COVID-19的分歧而抵制了投票。

sentences.en: Basically, quite a few of the Kanak indigenous groups refused to vote.
sentences.zh: 基本上，相当一部分卡纳克土著群体拒绝投票。

sentences.en: In New Caledonia, the population is quite divided over the issue of French independence.
sentences.zh: 在新喀里多尼亚，人口在法国独立问题上分歧相当大。

sentences.en: I said that 53% voted to stay part of France, which means 47% voted for independence.
sentences.zh: 我说过53%的人投票留在法国，这意味着47%的人投票支持独立。

sentences.en: But if you look at who is voting, the division becomes even clearer.
sentences.zh: 但如果你看看谁在投票，这种分歧就更加明显了。

sentences.en: The indigenous Kanak people make up about 40% of the population and overwhelmingly support independence.
sentences.zh: 土著卡纳克人占人口的40%左右，并且压倒性地支持独立。

sentences.en: Some surveys suggest over 90% of Kanak people want to be independent.
sentences.zh: 一些调查显示，超过90%的卡纳克人希望独立。

sentences.en: But the rest of the population, especially the people living in the large towns tend to be Europeans or descendants of Europeans who settled on the islands in the past or other Pacific Islanders now living in New Caledonia.
sentences.zh: 但其余人口，特别是生活在城镇里的人，往往是过去定居在岛上的欧洲人或欧洲人后裔，或者是现在居住在新喀里多尼亚的其他太平洋岛民。

sentences.en: These kinds of people tend to support being part of France.
sentences.zh: 这类人往往支持成为法国的一部分。

sentences.en: There are also independence or autonomy movements in other parts of Overseas France, in the French Caribbean and French Polynesia too.
sentences.zh: 在法属加勒比和法属波利尼西亚等海外法国的其他地区，也存在独立或自治运动。

sentences.en: But of course, not everyone in Overseas France wants independence.
sentences.zh: 但当然，外海法国并非人人都想要独立。

sentences.en: Outside of New Caledonia, the movements are relatively small.
sentences.zh: 除了新喀里多尼亚，这些运动相对较小。

sentences.en: And remember Mayotte. When the Comoros Islands became independent, Mayotte chose to remain French.
sentences.zh: 还记得马约特吗。当科摩罗群岛独立时，马约特选择保持法国属性。

sentences.en: So, what does the future look like for France and for Overseas France?
sentences.zh: 那么，法国和外海法国的未来会是什么样呢？

sentences.en: The different territories, the different islands, the different departments all have different relationships with France, and their populations have different opinions on what to do in the future.
sentences.zh: 不同的领地、不同的岛屿、不同的省份与法国有着不同的关系，其人口对未来的走向也有着不同的看法。

sentences.en: For places like Guadeloupe, Martinique, Réunion, French Guiana, independence isn’t something that seems to be discussed very often or seems likely.
sentences.zh: 对于瓜德罗普、马提尼克、留尼汪、法属圭亚那等地方来说，独立似乎并不是一个经常被讨论或者看似可能的话题。

sentences.en: People there are quite happy or seem relatively happy with being French and have the benefits of the EU.
sentences.zh: 那里的人们对于成为法国人相当满意，或者看起来相对满意，并享有欧盟带来的好处。

sentences.en: There are some small independence movements, but I think the people there value being part of France.
sentences.zh: 虽然存在一些小型独立运动，但我认为那里的民众很珍视成为法国的一部分。

sentences.en: So these territories are likely to remain French for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 因此，在可预见的未来，这些领地很可能继续保持法国属性。

sentences.en: Some people there do want greater autonomy.
sentences.zh: 那里的一些人确实希望获得更大的自治权。

sentences.en: Maybe they want more control over their education systems or taxation or immigration, while still remaining part of France.
sentences.zh: 也许他们希望对教育系统、税收或移民有更多控制权，同时仍然留在法国。

sentences.en: The thing about the French political system is you don’t necessarily have to choose between being completely controlled by Paris or becoming an independent country.
sentences.zh: 法国政治制度的特点在于，你不一定非要在完全受巴黎控制或成为独立国家之间二选一。

sentences.en: There are possible arrangements in between.
sentences.zh: 中间还存在着其他可能的安排。

sentences.en: The French collectivities like French Polynesia, for example, already have quite a lot of autonomy, and they are still part of the French Republic.
sentences.zh: 例如，像法属波利尼西亚这样的法国集体已经拥有相当大的自治权，而且它们仍然是法兰西共和国的一部分。

sentences.en: The biggest unknown issue for the future of Overseas France, though, is New Caledonia.
sentences.zh: 然而，海外法国未来最大的未知数是新喀里多尼亚。

sentences.en: In 2024, recently, there were deadly riots after France introduced a policy to change electoral rules.
sentences.zh: 就在2024年最近，在法国推出一项旨在改变选举规则的政策后，爆发了致命的骚乱。

sentences.en: The new policy made indigenous peoples angry because it was going to give more people the right to vote in New Caledonia.
sentences.zh: 这项新政策激怒了原住民，因为它将赋予更多人在新喀里多尼亚的投票权。

sentences.en: The French government has tried for a long time to create some kind of political compromise that recognizes the Kanak people and also keeps New Caledonia as part of France.
sentences.zh: 法国政府长期以来一直试图寻求某种政治妥协，既承认卡纳克人，又让新喀里多尼亚继续作为法国的一部分。

sentences.en: But finding a solution to this issue is really difficult, especially as the Kanak population is a large part of New Caledonia.
sentences.zh: 但要找到解决这一问题的方案确实非常困难，特别是卡纳克人口占了新喀里多尼亚很大一部分。

sentences.en: France likes to think of itself as more than a European country.
sentences.zh: 法国喜欢把自己看作是一个超越欧洲的国家。

sentences.en: France is a permanent member of the UN Security Council.
sentences.zh: 法国是联合国安理会常任理事国。

sentences.en: It has nuclear weapons. It has territories and citizens across the world.
sentences.zh: 它拥有核武器。它在世界各地拥有领地和公民。

sentences.en: So Overseas France is a really important part of France’s global identity.
sentences.zh: 因此，海外法国是法国全球身份中非常重要的组成部分。

sentences.en: Thanks to its overseas territories, France isn’t really just a European country.
sentences.zh: 由于拥有海外领地，法国其实不仅仅是一个欧洲国家。

sentences.en: It has land across the Caribbean, South America, the Indian Ocean, and the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 它在加勒比海、南美洲、印度洋和太平洋都拥有领土。

sentences.en: Like I mentioned at the beginning of this episode, France’s longest border is with Brazil.
sentences.zh: 正如我在本集开头提到的，法国最长的陆地边界是与巴西接壤的。

sentences.en: That’s such an incredible fact. You’d think it’s Spain, maybe Italy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个令人难以置信的事实。你可能会认为是西班牙，也许是意大利。

sentences.en: No, Brazil, because of French Guiana. Hopefully, in in this episode, you have learned a little bit about French identity and the history of Overseas France, as well as thinking about some of the issues, problems, and debates around these places.
sentences.zh: 不，是巴西，因为有法属圭亚那。希望通过本集，你对法国的身份认同和海外法国的历史有了一些了解，同时也思考了围绕这些地方的一些问题、矛盾和辩论。

sentences.en: Most of Overseas France seems very happy being French, but not everywhere does.
sentences.zh: 海外法国的大多数人似乎对身为法国人感到非常高兴，但并非所有地方都如此。

sentences.en: And New Caledonia is perhaps the biggest unknown question over the future of France.
sentences.zh: 而新喀里多尼亚也许是法国未来最大的未知数。

sentences.en: But what do you think? Have you ever been to any of these parts of Overseas France?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么看？你曾经去过海外法国的这些地方吗？
